'''2007 Utah State Championship Ryan Freeman LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Freeman]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
